data.narrative:
Limelight Steel is a pre-seed stage climate and energy company founded by Olivia Dippo and Andy Zhao that has raised $6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though peer-set constraints limit direct valuation triangulation.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable approach here. Using total capital raised of $6M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier for progression from pre-seed to the next funding stage yields an implied valuation of $15M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient narrow-set peers at the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier; while 9 same-sector companies exist, none satisfied the threshold of three or more datapoints across filtered criteria. The private peer universe includes Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, but these operate across different stages and valuations, limiting direct comparability.

The triangulated range derived from this single applicable method spans $13M (low) to $17M (high), with a median of $15M. Given reliance on one methodology, the key uncertainty is stage-appropriate valuation step-up assumptions; actual pre-seed to series A multiples vary materially by investor appetite and market conditions. Additional clarity on near-term capital needs and technical milestones would strengthen conviction in this range.
